name: Stacked Carousel
description: Vertical scroll stack of tilted image cards that pin near the top one after another, piling up on each other with title, year and genre tags overlaid on each card.
contents: One full-height scroll slot per card with image, title, year and genre chips
Soft blurred glow behind the stack
behavior: Each card pins to the top while the page scrolls, so later cards slide over earlier ones
Cards sit at alternating tilt angles and straighten on hover
Hover scales the card and zooms the image
editableByProps: Number of cards, titles, years, genre tags and images

needsCodeEdit.where: rotationClass logic inside the initialCards map

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the glow color or size
Change the scroll distance each card stays pinned

fixed: Pins each card with GSAP ScrollTrigger, using one viewport height of scroll per card
Includes a 30vh spacer below the stack to give the last pin scroll room
Glow behind the stack is fixed to the viewport
Card tilt angles are hardcoded and alternate by index
